integrity: Analytical proof uses published near-equal three-primes residue-uniform construction, an explicit complete modulo-seven table, and the published bounded-sum primorial envelope; finite code is only a check.
scientific_limitations: No explicit sufficiently-large threshold; the uniform defect and product-factor exponents are not claimed globally optimal; the opposite parity is not classified; a general known completion result may provide implicit coverage.
title: Constant-defect completion of distinct-prime partitions
